status_note: The covered projection requires byte-identical locked-oracle records for four zero-edge, non-FLAT structured-condition shapes, including two dispatches of the same object graph, ordered CALL/STORE/comment tokens, tree preservation, comment consumption, and modifier restoration. Complete PrintC structured emission remains MISMATCH: independently reviewed known residuals include Graph/MultiGoto dispatch, pending-brace callback behavior when an else-if condition has a prelude, and the FLAT+NOFALLTHRU basic-block tail. Else/if-goto/negation, markup, non-warning comments, error paths, remaining structured subtypes, and production CALL/STORE/CBRANCH presentation are additionally UNTESTED by this routing fixture.

rugra_source.isolation: Archive the pinned base commit and replace exactly src/printc.rs and src/varnode.rs with the hash-pinned live candidates; fixture files are copied separately and no other live source enters the Cargo snapshot.

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5; byte addressed
architecture.statement_atoms: The Ghidra FixturePrintC overrides opCall/opStore/opCbranch only to emit the deterministic atoms produced by the Rust comparand for this synthetic input. Ghidra's production emitBlockBasic/emitBlockLs/emitBlockCondition/emitBlockIf and comment protocol remain the dispatcher under test; production op presentation is explicitly excluded from the covered projection.

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no symbols, injections, or effects

analysis_options.entry: Direct public PrintC::emitBlockGraph/emit_block_graph over one root per case; no Action, Rule, decompile, declaration, or post-processing pipeline
analysis_options.rpn: Ghidra production RPN structured emitter; Rugra PrintC default rpn_enabled=true
analysis_options.comments: warning comments installed through the shared Architecture comment database; setupFunctionList/setup_function_comments runs once before two same-printer root dispatches, then once for a fresh-root probe
analysis_options.state_probe: Tree/edge/op snapshots before all emission and after two same-object dispatches plus post/fresh probes; a Basic CALL+terminal-CBRANCH sentinel is rendered by the post-target printer and a fresh printer
analysis_options.normalization: Pointer identities are replaced only by deterministic DFS-first-seen node ordinals. Op order is preserved as its position in the Basic op list. No emitted bytes, child order, comment order, alias occurrence, control-flow shape, or state decision is sorted or removed.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and all walks are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.shape: BlockIf(condition=BlockBasic[CALL 0x1001, terminal CBRANCH true], body=BlockBasic[STORE 0x5010<-0x61, terminal CBRANCH false])
cases.purpose: Basic condition dispatch; condition non-branch statement precedes if; no_branch suppresses terminal CBRANCH in condition prelude and body

cases.shape: outer BlockIf(condition=direct inner BlockIf(Basic[CALL,CBRANCH], Basic[CALL,STORE,CBRANCH]), body=Basic[STORE,CBRANCH])
cases.purpose: Condition object is itself BlockIf; locks virtual redispatch and proves the nested body CALL/STORE is not flattened away
Locks no_branch child-0-only selection and only_branch/comma_separate left-operator-right token order with per-child parentheses

cases.shape: outer BlockIf condition is BlockList[inner BlockIf(A, body CALL-free+STORE), BlockCondition(AND,B,C)]; outer body CALL-strdup+STORE; every Basic has a terminal CBRANCH
cases.purpose: Real getstr structural closure: sequential BlockList redispatch, direct inner If body preservation, compound trailing condition, ordered CALL/STORE/comments, and suppression of every body terminal branch
comments: INNER_FREE at the nested body CALL
COND_SECOND at BlockCondition child C's CBRANCH
OUTER_STORE at the outer body STORE

observation_schema.records: Five UTF-8 lines with final newline: one locked envelope and four fixed-order case records
observation_schema.tree: tree_before_hex/tree_after_hex encode DFS nodes as ordinal:type:index:flags:in/out counts:ordered child ordinals:ordered Basic opcode@address/list-position:ordered outgoing edges; tree_equal and sentinel_equal must be 1
observation_schema.raw: pass1_hex, pass2_hex, fresh_root_hex, post_hex, and fresh_post_hex are complete unmodified EmitNoMarkup bytes for each interval; post_fresh_equal must be 1
observation_schema.events: events1/events2/events_fresh preserve byte-position order for unique warning comments, CALL targets, STORE assignment tokens, if, boolean operators, and any leaked goto
observation_schema.comment_lifecycle: getstr comments must observe INNER_FREE/COND_SECOND/OUTER_STORE counts 1,1,1 on pass 1; 0,0,0 on pass 2 without setup reset; and 1,1,1 on a fresh printer after setup

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Both passes receive the identical root object and identical child aliases, PcodeOps, Varnodes, edges, Funcdata, Architecture, and comment database. Emit writes only to its output and Comment::emitted; tree/op/edge snapshots must remain identical.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: BlockIf dispatch order is condition under no_branch, comment-tree drain, condition under only_branch, then body under no_branch. BlockList walks children in stored order and passes the caller's original no_branch state only to its final child. BlockCondition no_branch emits only child 0; only_branch emits child 0, operator, child 1 in that order.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: A new emitted identity set is created once per emitBlockGraph call; the comment sorter is set up once before the two same-printer passes, so each comment transitions logically false->true on pass 1 and stays true on pass 2; modifier push/pop depth must return to its incoming state before the sentinel.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No structure or event sorting is permitted. DFS identity numbering is first-seen only; Basic operations retain insertion order; CommentSorter retains its locked (block index, op order, uniqueness position) order; events sort solely by actual byte offset with a fixed tie priority.

uncovered: emitBlockIf else, else-if pending-brace merge, if-goto, break/continue/goto target, negation, markup, and error paths

All fixture FlowBlocks have zero outgoing edges: nextInFlow one/two-edge selection, NOFALLTHRU, and FLAT tail emission are not covered; the current FLAT+NOFALLTHRU implementation is a registered MISMATCH
Graph and BlockMultiGoto dispatch are registered MISMATCH; BlockCopy, BlockGoto, WhileDo/DoWhile/InfLoop, Switch, Plain, and malformed/cyclic/duplicate graphs are UNTESTED here
Pending-brace callback behavior for an else-if whose condition emits prelude statements is a registered MISMATCH; ordinary else/else-if and if-goto paths are otherwise UNTESTED here
Production FuncCallSpecs, datatype/symbol resolution, and opCall/opStore/opCbranch text presentation
Full getstr Funcdata/CFG/SSA/types/comments; only its locked structured BlockList condition shape is represented
